item.title: Version 7.1.4b1
item.description: Fixes jumping and uneven scrollbar movement in the Social timeline by using stable, exact row heights. Keeps image loading out of row measurement and removes animations during width-driven height updates. Universal app for Apple silicon and Intel, Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled.

item.title: Version 7.0.4b5
item.description: Improves timeline scrolling with cached title formatting and cell layouts, in-place row updates, and background thumbnail decoding. News uses smaller decoded thumbnails; Blog skips thumbnail loading. Universal app, Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled.
